# napari-aibirthday

AI birthday video generator from a single photo: they pop champagne on a park bench, blow out a Scorpio cake, or light a crown cake at the car window.

Official napari plugin for [AI Birthday Video Generator](https://aibirthdayvideogenerator.com/?utm_source=napari&utm_medium=package) (`https://aibirthdayvideogenerator.com/`). Generate 12-second 720p vertical (`9:16`) birthday video clips on `seedance-2-mini` and open the decoded frame stack directly as a napari image layer.

- Create an API key at [API Keys](https://aibirthdayvideogenerator.com/settings/apikeys) and set `ABVG_API_KEY`.
- Scene guides: [Read the Docs](https://aibirthdayvideogenerator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) · Credit packs: [Pricing](https://aibirthdayvideogenerator.com/pricing?utm_source=napari&utm_medium=package).
- Source code: [github.com/hanshs474/napari-aibirthday](https://github.com/hanshs474/napari-aibirthday).

## Install

```bash
pip install napari-aibirthday
```

## Usage

Open **Plugins → AI Birthday Video Generator** in napari, paste your prompt and optional portrait URL, and click **Generate Birthday Video**.
